data.narrative:
Percepto is a Series C autonomous systems company in the Drones & Autonomous sector, having raised $128M to date. The comp universe comprises six private firms in the broader drones and autonomous space, including Zipline, Joby Aviation, Nuro, Archer Aviation, and Elroy Air. No public comparable exists in this narrow category, limiting traditional multiples-based analysis.

Given data constraints, stage-progression methodology is the sole applicable triangulation approach. Using total capital raised of $128M as a valuation proxy and applying a 1.7x multiplier typical of Series C-to-next-stage progression yields an implied valuation of $218M. This method assumes Percepto's prior fundraising rounds reflected fair-value pricing and that the step-up rate aligns with peer financing patterns, though frontier-tech volatility introduces execution risk not captured in mechanical advancement.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $185M to $250M, with a median of $218M. The range reflects ±15% sensitivity around the stage-progression result, acknowledging both upside (if capital deployment and product traction exceed cohort norms) and downside (if market conditions tighten or competitive pressures intensify). Key uncertainties remain: the absence of robust same-stage private comparables limits cross-validation; the applicability of standard stage multipliers to autonomous systems—a category with atypical capital requirements and timeline-to-revenue—is unverified; and forward valuation hinges critically on execution milestones and market adoption trajectories not visible in historical raising data.
